title: Wire TTS and STT API key env vars into voice adapters
description:
Update TTS and STT adapters to use TTS_API_KEY/STT_API_KEY environment variables. Before editing, inspect: current TTS/STT implementations in chatbot/voice.

1. Add environment variable loading to chatbot/voice/tts.py and chatbot/voice/stt.py
2. Update .env.example with new vars
3. Ensure clear error if keys missing
acceptance_criteria: TTS/STT modules raise clear error when keys not set
